request.query: Cabidos (unit of length). CABIDOS, or CAVIDOS, a long measure ufed at Goa, and in other places of the East Indies belonging to the Portuguese, to measure fluffs, linens, Ge, and equal to 4 of the Paris eli.
documents: Cabidos (French pronunciation:; Occitan: Cabidòs) is a commune in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques department in south-western France.
